id-20260820-news-1.title: BI Holds Benchmark Interest Rate at 5.75 Percent, Destry Damayanti's Inaugural RDG as Acting Governor of BI

segments.src: Bank Indonesia (BI) memutuskan untuk kembali menahan suku bunga acuan atau BI Rate di level 5,75 persen dalam Rapat Dewan Gubernur (RDG) yang berlangsung pada 19 Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: Bank Indonesia (BI) decided to keep the benchmark interest rate or BI Rate at the level of 5.75 percent during the Board of Governors Meeting (RDG) held on August 19, 2026.

segments.src: Keputusan ini menjadi catatan tersendiri karena untuk pertama kalinya hasil RDG diumumkan langsung oleh Destry Damayanti dalam kapasitasnya sebagai Pejabat sementara (Pjs) Gubernur BI.
segments.tr: This decision is a notable milestone as it is the first time the RDG results were announced directly by Destry Damayanti in her capacity as Acting (Pjs) Governor of BI.

segments.src: ## Suku Bunga Ditahan, Dua Instrumen Lain Juga Stabil
segments.tr: ## Interest Rate Held, Two Other Instruments Also Stable

segments.src: Selain BI Rate, dua suku bunga acuan lain yang biasanya bergerak seiring kebijakan utama juga dilaporkan tetap berada pada level sebelumnya, yakni suku bunga Deposit Facility dan Lending Facility.
segments.tr: Aside from the BI Rate, two other benchmark interest rates that typically move in tandem with the primary policy were also reported to remain at their previous levels, namely the Deposit Facility and Lending Facility interest rates.

segments.src: Konsistensi ini mencerminkan sikap kebijakan moneter yang cenderung berhati-hati atau wait and see di tengah dinamika perekonomian global yang belum sepenuhnya stabil.
segments.tr: This consistency reflects a monetary policy stance that tends to be cautious or wait and see amidst global economic dynamics that are not yet fully stable.

segments.src: Keputusan menahan suku bunga acuan umumnya diambil bank sentral ketika kondisi inflasi domestik dinilai masih berada dalam rentang target, sembari tetap mencermati faktor-faktor eksternal yang berpotensi memengaruhi nilai tukar dan arus modal.
segments.tr: The decision to hold the benchmark interest rate is generally taken by central banks when domestic inflation conditions are assessed to still be within the target range, while continuing to monitor external factors that have the potential to affect exchange rates and capital flows.

segments.src: ## Fokus pada Stabilitas Rupiah di Tengah Gejolak Timur Tengah
segments.tr: ## Focus on Rupiah Stability Amidst Middle East Turmoil

segments.src: Salah satu pertimbangan utama di balik keputusan RDG kali ini adalah menjaga stabilitas nilai tukar rupiah.
segments.tr: One of the primary considerations behind this RDG decision is to maintain the stability of the rupiah exchange rate.

segments.src: Ketegangan geopolitik di kawasan Timur Tengah dalam beberapa waktu terakhir turut memberikan tekanan terhadap pasar keuangan global, termasuk fluktuasi harga energi dan aliran modal ke negara-negara berkembang seperti Indonesia.
segments.tr: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East region in recent times have also exerted pressure on global financial markets, including energy price fluctuations and capital flows to developing countries like Indonesia.

segments.src: Dalam situasi seperti ini, bank sentral biasanya berupaya menyeimbangkan dua kepentingan sekaligus, yaitu mendukung momentum pertumbuhan ekonomi domestik dan menjaga daya tarik pasar keuangan dalam negeri bagi investor agar rupiah tidak mengalami tekanan berlebihan.
segments.tr: In such situations, central banks typically strive to balance two interests simultaneously, namely supporting domestic economic growth momentum and maintaining the attractiveness of the domestic financial market for investors so that the rupiah does not experience excessive pressure.

segments.src: Mempertahankan suku bunga pada level yang dianggap masih kompetitif menjadi salah satu instrumen untuk mencapai keseimbangan tersebut, di samping langkah-langkah stabilisasi lain yang lazim ditempuh otoritas moneter.
segments.tr: Maintaining interest rates at a level considered still competitive is one of the instruments to achieve this balance, alongside other stabilization measures commonly pursued by monetary authorities.

segments.src: ## Sosok Destry Damayanti dan Momen RDG Perdana
segments.tr: ## Destry Damayanti's Figure and Inaugural RDG Moment

segments.src: RDG 19 Agustus 2026 menjadi momen penting bagi Destry Damayanti, yang sebelumnya dikenal luas menjabat sebagai Deputi Gubernur Senior BI.
segments.tr: The August 19, 2026 RDG marks an important moment for Destry Damayanti, who was previously widely known for serving as the Senior Deputy Governor of BI.

segments.src: Penunjukannya sebagai Pjs Gubernur membuat dirinya kini bertanggung jawab memimpin dan mengumumkan hasil rapat kebijakan moneter tertinggi di institusi tersebut untuk pertama kalinya.
segments.tr: Her appointment as Acting Governor makes her now responsible for leading and announcing the results of the highest monetary policy meeting at the institution for the first time.

segments.src: Sebagai figur yang telah lama berkecimpung di lingkungan kebijakan moneter dan makroprudensial, kehadirannya di posisi Pjs Gubernur diharapkan dapat menjaga kesinambungan arah kebijakan BI di tengah masa transisi kepemimpinan, sekaligus memberikan sinyal kepada pelaku pasar bahwa proses pengambilan keputusan tetap berjalan sesuai kerangka kerja yang telah ditetapkan sebelumnya.
segments.tr: As a figure who has long been involved in the monetary and macroprudential policy environment, her presence in the Acting Governor position is expected to maintain the continuity of BI's policy direction amidst the leadership transition period, while signaling to market participants that the decision-making process continues to run according to previously established frameworks.

segments.src: ## Respons dan Perhatian Pelaku Pasar
segments.tr: ## Response and Attention of Market Participants

segments.src: Keputusan mempertahankan suku bunga acuan umumnya disambut sebagai sinyal kehati-hatian oleh pelaku pasar keuangan, perbankan, maupun dunia usaha.
segments.tr: The decision to maintain the benchmark interest rate is generally welcomed as a signal of caution by financial market participants, banking sectors, and the business world.

segments.src: Bagi sektor perbankan, suku bunga acuan yang stabil memberikan kepastian dalam menyusun strategi bunga simpanan dan kredit dalam beberapa bulan ke depan.
segments.tr: For the banking sector, a stable benchmark interest rate provides certainty in formulating deposit and credit interest strategies in the coming months.

segments.src: Sementara itu, pelaku pasar valuta asing dan investor turut mencermati pernyataan-pernyataan lanjutan dari BI terkait proyeksi inflasi, pertumbuhan ekonomi, serta perkembangan situasi global yang dapat memengaruhi arah kebijakan berikutnya.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, foreign exchange market participants and investors are also closely monitoring further statements from BI regarding inflation projections, economic growth, and global situation developments that could influence the direction of future policies.

segments.src: Ke depan, publik dan pelaku pasar akan menantikan bagaimana kepemimpinan BI di bawah Pjs Gubernur Destry Damayanti mengelola dinamika kebijakan moneter, khususnya dalam merespons perkembangan situasi geopolitik global serta menjaga stabilitas makroekonomi nasional hingga proses pergantian kepemimpinan definitif BI rampung.
segments.tr: Going forward, the public and market participants will look forward to how BI's leadership under Acting Governor Destry Damayanti manages monetary policy dynamics, particularly in responding to global geopolitical situation developments and maintaining national macroeconomic stability until BI's definitive leadership transition process is completed.

id-20260820-news-2.title: Antam Gold Prices Plunge Rp50,000 After Nearing Record High, US Bond Yields Triggered the Drop

segments.src: Harga emas batangan Antam terkoreksi tajam pada perdagangan Rabu, 19 Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: Antam's gold bar prices saw a sharp correction in trading on Wednesday, August 19, 2026.

segments.src: Berdasarkan data resmi dari laman Logam Mulia, harga emas Antam ukuran 1 gram tercatat turun Rp50.000 menjadi Rp2.645.000 per gram, setelah dalam beberapa hari terakhir sempat melesat naik dan mendekati level rekor tertingginya.
segments.tr: Based on official data from the Logam Mulia page, the price of a 1-gram Antam gold bar was recorded down by Rp50,000 to Rp2,645,000 per gram, after surging over the past few days and nearing its all-time high record level.

segments.src: ## Koreksi Setelah Reli Kenaikan
segments.tr: ## Correction After a Rally

segments.src: Penurunan ini terbilang cukup signifikan mengingat tren harga emas Antam belakangan justru menunjukkan penguatan yang konsisten.
segments.tr: This drop is quite significant considering Antam's gold price trend has recently shown consistent strengthening.

segments.src: Sebelum terkoreksi, harga emas sempat naik beruntun dan hampir menyentuh rekor tertinggi sepanjang sejarah, seiring tingginya minat investor terhadap aset safe haven di tengah ketidakpastian ekonomi global.
segments.tr: Before the correction, gold prices had risen consecutively and nearly touched their all-time high record, driven by high investor interest in safe-haven assets amid global economic uncertainty.

segments.src: Koreksi harga pada hari ini menjadi pengingat bahwa pergerakan harga emas, meski cenderung menguat dalam jangka panjang, tetap fluktuatif dan dapat berbalik arah dalam waktu singkat mengikuti dinamika pasar keuangan global.
segments.tr: Today's price correction serves as a reminder that gold price movements, while tending to strengthen in the long term, remain volatile and can reverse direction in a short time following global financial market dynamics.

segments.src: ## Yield Obligasi AS Naik, Emas Tertekan
segments.tr: ## US Bond Yields Rise, Gold Under Pressure

segments.src: Salah satu faktor utama yang disebut menjadi pemicu koreksi harga emas adalah kenaikan yield atau imbal hasil obligasi pemerintah Amerika Serikat (US Treasury).
segments.tr: One of the main factors cited as triggering the gold price correction is the rise in yields on US government bonds (US Treasury).

segments.src: Ketika yield obligasi AS naik, instrumen tersebut menjadi lebih menarik bagi investor karena menawarkan imbal hasil yang lebih kompetitif dibandingkan emas, yang notabene tidak memberikan bunga atau dividen.
segments.tr: When US bond yields rise, these instruments become more attractive to investors because they offer more competitive returns compared to gold, which inherently does not provide interest or dividends.

segments.src: Kondisi ini mendorong sebagian investor mengalihkan portofolionya dari emas ke instrumen obligasi, sehingga menekan permintaan sekaligus harga emas di pasar global.
segments.tr: This condition prompts some investors to shift their portfolios from gold to bond instruments, thereby suppressing demand as well as gold prices in the global market.

segments.src: Penguatan dolar AS yang biasanya mengiringi kenaikan yield obligasi turut menambah tekanan terhadap harga emas, karena membuat emas menjadi relatif lebih mahal bagi investor yang menggunakan mata uang lain.
segments.tr: The strengthening of the US dollar, which usually accompanies the rise in bond yields, further adds pressure on gold prices by making gold relatively more expensive for investors using other currencies.

segments.src: ## Ketegangan AS-Iran Picu Kekhawatiran Inflasi
segments.tr: ## US-Iran Tensions Trigger Inflation Concerns

segments.src: Selain faktor yield obligasi, memanasnya ketegangan geopolitik antara Amerika Serikat dan Iran turut menjadi sorotan pelaku pasar.
segments.tr: Apart from bond yield factors, escalating geopolitical tensions between the United States and Iran have also become a focal point for market players.

segments.src: Eskalasi ketegangan di kawasan tersebut menimbulkan kekhawatiran terhadap potensi gangguan pasokan energi global, yang pada gilirannya dapat memicu tekanan inflasi di berbagai negara, termasuk Amerika Serikat.
segments.tr: The escalation of tensions in the region raises concerns over potential global energy supply disruptions, which in turn could trigger inflationary pressures in various countries, including the United States.

segments.src: Kekhawatiran inflasi ini menciptakan dinamika yang kompleks di pasar.
segments.tr: These inflation concerns create complex dynamics in the market.

segments.src: Di satu sisi, ketidakpastian geopolitik biasanya mendorong investor mencari aset aman seperti emas.
segments.tr: On one hand, geopolitical uncertainty usually drives investors to seek safe-haven assets like gold.

segments.src: Namun di sisi lain, ekspektasi bahwa bank sentral AS (The Fed) mungkin mempertahankan suku bunga tinggi lebih lama guna meredam inflasi turut menopang kenaikan yield obligasi, yang justru menekan harga emas dalam jangka pendek.
segments.tr: However, on the other hand, expectations that the US central bank (The Fed) might keep interest rates high for longer to curb inflation also support the rise in bond yields, which in turn pressures gold prices in the short term.

segments.src: ## Harga Buyback dan Pergerakan Harian
segments.tr: ## Buyback Prices and Daily Movements

segments.src: Selain harga jual, Antam juga menetapkan harga buyback atau harga pembelian kembali emas dari nasabah yang turut mengalami penyesuaian mengikuti pergerakan harga jual.
segments.tr: In addition to the selling price, Antam also sets the buyback price—the price for repurchasing gold from customers—which has also experienced adjustments following the movement of the selling price.

segments.src: Calon pembeli maupun pemilik emas batangan disarankan untuk memantau harga terkini secara langsung melalui laman resmi Logam Mulia atau aplikasi resmi Antam, mengingat harga emas dapat berubah setiap hari bahkan dalam hitungan jam mengikuti pergerakan pasar global.
segments.tr: Prospective buyers and owners of gold bars are advised to monitor the latest prices directly through the official Logam Mulia page or the official Antam application, given that gold prices can change daily or even within hours following global market movements.

segments.src: ## Proyeksi ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Future Outlook

segments.src: Para pelaku pasar menilai arah harga emas dalam waktu dekat akan sangat bergantung pada perkembangan lanjutan di dua front utama: kebijakan suku bunga bank sentral AS serta perkembangan situasi geopolitik di Timur Tengah.
segments.tr: Market players assess that the direction of gold prices in the near future will heavily depend on further developments on two main fronts: US central bank interest rate policies and geopolitical situation developments in the Middle East.

segments.src: Apabila ketegangan AS-Iran mereda dan data inflasi AS menunjukkan tren melandai, tekanan terhadap harga emas berpotensi mereda dan membuka ruang penguatan kembali menuju level rekor.
segments.tr: If US-Iran tensions ease and US inflation data shows a downward trend, the pressure on gold prices could potentially subside and open room for a recovery toward record levels.

segments.src: Sebaliknya, jika yield obligasi AS terus menanjak seiring ekspektasi suku bunga tinggi berkepanjangan, harga emas berisiko melanjutkan tren konsolidasi atau bahkan koreksi lebih lanjut dalam jangka pendek.
segments.tr: Conversely, if US bond yields continue to climb alongside expectations of prolonged high interest rates, gold prices risk continuing their consolidation trend or even correcting further in the short term.

id-20260820-news-3.title: FTSE Russell Delays Addition of New Indonesian Stocks Again Until December 2026, Foreign Investors Await Exchange Reforms

segments.src: FTSE Russell kembali menunda rencana penambahan sejumlah emiten Indonesia, termasuk beberapa perusahaan hasil penawaran umum perdana (IPO), ke dalam daftar konstituen indeksnya.
segments.tr: FTSE Russell has again delayed its plan to add several Indonesian issuers, including several initial public offering (IPO) companies, to its index constituent list.

segments.src: Penundaan ini menggeser jadwal peninjauan (review) resmi hingga periode Desember 2026, lebih lambat dari perkiraan awal pelaku pasar.
segments.tr: This delay pushes the official review schedule back to the December 2026 period, later than market participants' initial expectations.

segments.src: ## Alasan di Balik Penundaan
segments.tr: ## Reasons Behind the Delay

segments.src: Menurut informasi yang beredar di kalangan pelaku pasar, penundaan tersebut berkaitan dengan proses evaluasi berkelanjutan yang dilakukan penyedia indeks global ini terhadap kualitas keterbukaan informasi kepemilikan saham (ownership transparency) di Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI).
segments.tr: According to information circulating among market participants, the delay is related to the ongoing evaluation process conducted by this global index provider regarding the quality of share ownership transparency disclosure on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX).

segments.src: FTSE Russell dikenal memiliki metodologi ketat dalam menentukan bobot dan status suatu pasar maupun saham individual dalam indeksnya, termasuk syarat terkait free float, likuiditas perdagangan, serta kejelasan struktur kepemilikan.
segments.tr: FTSE Russell is known for having a strict methodology in determining the weight and status of a market as well as individual stocks within its index, including requirements related to free float, trading liquidity, and clarity of ownership structure.

segments.src: Sejumlah analis pasar modal menilai bahwa keputusan ini bukan semata-mata sinyal negatif terhadap prospek ekonomi Indonesia, melainkan bagian dari proses standar yang biasa dilakukan penyedia indeks sebelum memasukkan saham baru secara resmi.
segments.tr: A number of capital market analysts assess that this decision is not solely a negative signal regarding Indonesia's economic prospects, but rather part of a standard process usually carried out by index providers before officially including new stocks.

segments.src: Proses semacam ini umumnya membutuhkan waktu untuk memastikan data dan mekanisme pasar telah memenuhi standar internasional yang konsisten.
segments.tr: This type of process generally takes time to ensure that data and market mechanisms meet consistent international standards.

segments.src: ## Reformasi Transparansi Jadi Sorotan
segments.tr: ## Transparency Reform in the Spotlight

segments.src: Otoritas bursa dan regulator pasar modal di dalam negeri disebut tengah mendorong sejumlah pembenahan, salah satunya terkait keterbukaan data kepemilikan saham oleh investor pengendali maupun pemegang saham mayoritas.
segments.tr: Domestic exchange authorities and capital market regulators are reportedly pushing for a number of improvements, one of which relates to the disclosure of share ownership data by controlling investors and majority shareholders.

segments.src: Langkah reformasi ini dipandang penting agar Indonesia dapat memenuhi kriteria yang ditetapkan oleh lembaga penyedia indeks global, tidak hanya FTSE Russell tetapi juga penyedia indeks lain yang menjadi acuan investor institusi dunia.
segments.tr: This reform step is seen as important so that Indonesia can meet the criteria established by global index provider institutions, not only FTSE Russell but also other index providers that serve as benchmarks for global institutional investors.

segments.src: Beberapa pengamat pasar modal menyampaikan bahwa efektivitas dari reformasi tersebut akan menjadi salah satu variabel penting yang dipantau hingga tenggat peninjauan berikutnya.
segments.tr: Several capital market observers conveyed that the effectiveness of these reforms will be one of the important variables monitored until the next review deadline.

segments.src: Jika perbaikan tata kelola dan transparansi dapat diterapkan secara konsisten, peluang bagi emiten-emiten baru RI, termasuk yang baru melantai lewat IPO, untuk masuk ke dalam konstituen indeks global akan semakin terbuka.
segments.tr: If governance and transparency improvements can be implemented consistently, the opportunities for new Indonesian issuers, including those that have recently gone public via IPO, to enter global index constituents will become increasingly open.

segments.src: ## Dampak terhadap Investor Asing
segments.tr: ## Impact on Foreign Investors

segments.src: Keputusan penundaan ini turut menjadi perhatian bagi investor asing yang selama ini menjadikan indeks FTSE Russell sebagai salah satu acuan alokasi portofolio di pasar negara berkembang.
segments.tr: This postponement decision has also become a focus of attention for foreign investors who have long used the FTSE Russell index as one of their portfolio allocation benchmarks in emerging markets.

segments.src: Masuknya suatu saham ke dalam indeks global umumnya berpotensi mendorong arus masuk dana investasi pasif (passive fund) yang mengacu pada indeks tersebut, sehingga penundaan dapat berarti tertundanya pula potensi inflow dari instrumen-instrumen yang melacak indeks tersebut.
segments.tr: The inclusion of a stock in a global index generally has the potential to drive passive investment fund inflows that reference the index, so a delay may mean a postponement of potential inflows from instruments tracking that index.

segments.src: Meski demikian, sejumlah pelaku pasar mengingatkan bahwa dinamika seperti ini lazim terjadi di berbagai pasar berkembang lain dan tidak serta-merta mencerminkan penurunan minat investor terhadap pasar modal Indonesia secara keseluruhan.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, a number of market participants remind that such dynamics are common in various other emerging markets and do not necessarily reflect a decline in investor interest in the Indonesian capital market as a whole.

segments.src: Fundamental ekonomi domestik, kinerja emiten, serta likuiditas perdagangan harian tetap menjadi faktor penentu utama arah pergerakan pasar dalam jangka pendek hingga menengah.
segments.tr: Domestic economic fundamentals, issuer performance, and daily trading liquidity remain the main determining factors for market direction in the short to medium term.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Dipantau Investor
segments.tr: ## What Investors Need to Monitor

segments.src: Bagi investor maupun pelaku pasar yang mengikuti perkembangan ini, beberapa hal yang layak dicermati ke depan antara lain adalah:
segments.tr: For investors and market participants following this development, several things worth watching going forward include:

segments.src: - Perkembangan implementasi kebijakan transparansi kepemilikan saham oleh regulator dan BEI.
segments.tr: - The progress of the implementation of share ownership transparency policies by regulators and the IDX.

segments.src: - Jadwal resmi peninjauan indeks FTSE Russell pada Desember 2026 serta kemungkinan perubahan status pasar Indonesia.
segments.tr: - The official FTSE Russell index review schedule in December 2026 as well as potential changes to Indonesia's market status.

segments.src: - Respons emiten hasil IPO terkait pemenuhan syarat free float dan keterbukaan informasi.
segments.tr: - The response of IPO issuers regarding compliance with free float requirements and information disclosure.

segments.src: - Pergerakan arus dana asing di pasar saham domestik sebagai indikator sentimen investor institusi.
segments.tr: - Foreign fund flow movements in the domestic stock market as an indicator of institutional investor sentiment.

segments.src: Perkembangan lebih lanjut mengenai keputusan ini disarankan untuk terus dipantau melalui saluran resmi otoritas bursa maupun publikasi resmi FTSE Russell, mengingat kebijakan indeks dapat berubah sewaktu-waktu sesuai hasil evaluasi berkala.
segments.tr: Further developments regarding this decision are advised to continue to be monitored through the official channels of the exchange authority and official FTSE Russell publications, considering that index policies can change at any time according to periodic evaluation results.

id-20260820-intro-agriculture-2.title: [Agronomy #2] Rice, Sugarcane, and Coffee: Why Farmers Count Plant "Age", Not Just Water Them

segments.src: > Tanaman budidaya dikelompokkan berdasarkan apa yang kita ambil darinya, dan setiap tanaman melewati tahap hidup yang berurutan — mengenali tahap itu menentukan kapan memupuk, mengairi, dan memanen.
segments.tr: > Cultivated plants are grouped based on what we harvest from them, and every plant goes through a sequential life stage — recognizing those stages determines when to fertilize, irrigate, and harvest.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Bayangkan Anda punya dua pot di halaman: satu ditanami bayam, satu lagi ditanami cabai.
segments.tr: Imagine you have two pots in the yard: one planted with spinach, another planted with chili peppers.

segments.src: Keduanya "tanaman", tetapi cara Anda memperlakukannya berbeda.
segments.tr: Both are "plants", but the way you treat them differs.

segments.src: Bayam Anda panen daunnya sebelum berbunga.
segments.tr: You harvest the leaves of your spinach before it flowers.

segments.src: Cabai justru harus dibiarkan berbunga dulu, karena yang Anda tunggu adalah buahnya.
segments.tr: Chili peppers actually must be allowed to flower first, because what you are waiting for is the fruit.

segments.src: Perbedaan sederhana ini adalah inti dari dua hal yang dipelajari agronomi: **klasifikasi tanaman** dan **stadia pertumbuhan**.
segments.tr: This simple difference is the core of two things studied in agronomy: **plant classification** and **growth stages**.

segments.src: **Pertama, klasifikasi berdasarkan kegunaan.**
segments.tr: **First, classification by utility.**

segments.src: Agronom biasa membagi tanaman budidaya (di Indonesia sering disebut *tanaman pangan* dan *tanaman perkebunan*) menjadi beberapa kelompok besar:
segments.tr: Agronomists typically divide cultivated plants (often called *food crops* and *estate crops* in Indonesia) into several major groups:

segments.src: - **Tanaman pangan (food crops)** — hasilnya langsung dimakan sebagai sumber energi atau gizi. Termasuk di sini serealia (padi, jagung), umbi-umbian (singkong, ubi jalar, kentang), dan kacang-kacangan (kedelai, kacang tanah).
segments.tr: - **Food crops** — their yield is consumed directly as a source of energy or nutrition. This includes cereals (rice, corn), root crops (cassava, sweet potato, potato), and legumes (soybean, peanut).

segments.src: - **Tanaman industri / perkebunan (industrial crops)** — hasilnya diolah dulu sebelum dipakai. Tebu untuk gula, kapas untuk serat, kelapa sawit dan wijen untuk minyak, tembakau, karet, kopi, kakao.
segments.tr: - **Industrial / estate crops** — their yield is processed first before use. Sugarcane for sugar, cotton for fiber, oil palm and sesame for oil, tobacco, rubber, coffee, cocoa.

segments.src: - **Tanaman hortikultura** — sayuran, buah-buahan, dan tanaman hias. Umumnya bernilai tinggi per satuan luas tapi cepat rusak.
segments.tr: - **Horticultural crops** — vegetables, fruits, and ornamental plants. Generally high value per unit area but perishable.

segments.src: - **Tanaman pakan dan pupuk hijau** — rumput gajah, kacang-kacangan penutup tanah, yang ditanam untuk ternak atau untuk dikembalikan ke tanah.
segments.tr: - **Forage crops and green manure** — elephant grass, cover legumes, planted for livestock or to be returned to the soil.

segments.src: Ada juga cara membagi lain yang sering dipakai: berdasarkan **umur** (semusim seperti padi dan jagung; tahunan seperti kopi dan sawit) dan berdasarkan **jalur fotosintesis** (padi dan kedelai termasuk tipe C3; jagung dan tebu termasuk C4, yang lebih efisien di suhu tinggi dan cahaya kuat — salah satu alasan jagung dan tebu tumbuh baik di iklim tropis).
segments.tr: There are also other frequently used ways of dividing them: by **age** (annuals like rice and corn; perennials like coffee and palm) and by **photosynthetic pathway** (rice and soybean belong to the C3 type; corn and sugarcane belong to C4, which is more efficient at high temperatures and strong light — one of the reasons corn and sugarcane grow well in tropical climates).

segments.src: **Kedua, stadia pertumbuhan.**
segments.tr: **Second, growth stages.**

segments.src: Tanaman tidak tumbuh "rata" sepanjang hidupnya.
segments.tr: Plants do not grow "flat" throughout their lives.

segments.src: Ia melewati urutan tahap yang bisa dibagi jadi dua fase besar:
segments.tr: They go through a sequence of stages that can be divided into two major phases:

segments.src: 1. **Fase vegetatif** — perkecambahan, munculnya daun, pembentukan anakan (pada padi), pemanjangan batang. Tanaman sedang membangun "pabrik" berupa daun dan akar.
segments.tr: 1. **Vegetative phase** — germination, leaf emergence, tillering (in rice), stem elongation. The plant is building a "factory" in the form of leaves and roots.

segments.src: 2. **Fase generatif (reproduktif)** — pembentukan bunga, penyerbukan, pengisian biji atau buah, lalu pemasakan. Tanaman memindahkan hasil fotosintesis ke bagian yang akan kita panen.
segments.tr: 2. **Generative (reproductive) phase** — flower formation, pollination, grain or fruit filling, then ripening. The plant transfers photosynthetic products to the parts we will harvest.

segments.src: Pada padi, urutannya kira-kira: berkecambah → anakan (*tillering*) → bunting (*booting*) → keluar malai (*heading*) → berbunga → pengisian gabah → masak.
segments.tr: In rice, the sequence is roughly: germination → tillering → booting → heading → flowering → grain filling → ripening.

segments.src: Total sekitar 100–120 hari untuk varietas yang umum ditanam di Indonesia.
segments.tr: Totaling around 100–120 days for varieties commonly grown in Indonesia.

segments.src: Kenapa ini penting?
segments.tr: Why is this important?

segments.src: Karena **setiap tahap punya kebutuhan berbeda dan kepekaan berbeda**.
segments.tr: Because **every stage has different needs and different sensitivities**.

segments.src: Pupuk nitrogen paling berguna saat fase anakan; diberikan terlalu telat, ia justru bikin daun rimbun tapi gabah sedikit.
segments.tr: Nitrogen fertilizer is most useful during the tillering phase; applied too late, it actually makes the leaves lush but yields few grains.

segments.src: Sebaliknya, kekurangan air saat fase berbunga jauh lebih merusak hasil dibanding kekurangan air di fase vegetatif awal — di titik itu tanaman hampir tidak bisa "memperbaiki diri".
segments.tr: Conversely, water shortage during the flowering phase is much more damaging to yield than water shortage in the early vegetative phase — at that point the plant can hardly "repair itself".

segments.src: **Ketiga, faktor lingkungan tumbuh.**
segments.tr: **Third, growing environment factors.**

segments.src: Apa yang menentukan tanaman tumbuh baik atau tidak?
segments.tr: What determines whether a plant grows well or not?

segments.src: Secara ringkas ada empat kelompok:
segments.tr: In short, there are four groups:

segments.src: - **Iklim** — cahaya matahari, suhu, curah hujan, kelembapan, angin. Ini yang paling sulit dikendalikan petani.
segments.tr: - **Climate** — sunlight, temperature, rainfall, humidity, wind. This is the hardest for farmers to control.

segments.src: - **Tanah (edafik)** — tekstur, kandungan bahan organik, pH, unsur hara, drainase.
segments.tr: - **Soil (edaphic)** — texture, organic matter content, pH, nutrients, drainage.

segments.src: - **Biotik** — hama, penyakit, gulma, mikroba tanah yang menguntungkan seperti *Rhizobium* pada akar kacang-kacangan.
segments.tr: - **Biotic** — pests, diseases, weeds, beneficial soil microbes like *Rhizobium* on legume roots.

segments.src: - **Pengelolaan** — jarak tanam, waktu tanam, pemupukan, irigasi, varietas yang dipilih.
segments.tr: - **Management** — planting distance, planting time, fertilization, irrigation, chosen variety.

segments.src: Ada prinsip klasik yang berguna diingat, sering disebut **hukum minimum** (Liebig): hasil panen dibatasi oleh faktor yang paling kurang, bukan oleh rata-rata semua faktor.
segments.tr: There is a classic principle worth remembering, often called **Liebig's law of the minimum**: crop yield is limited by the most scarce factor, not by the average of all factors.

segments.src: Kalau tanah subur, air cukup, matahari melimpah, tapi pH tanah terlalu masam sehingga fosfor tidak terserap — maka pH-lah yang menentukan hasil Anda.
segments.tr: If the soil is fertile, water is sufficient, sunlight is abundant, but the soil pH is too acidic so phosphorus cannot be absorbed — then the pH determines your yield.

segments.src: Menambah pupuk nitrogen tidak akan menolong.
segments.tr: Adding nitrogen fertilizer will not help.

segments.src: Dalam bentuk sederhana:
segments.tr: In simple terms:

segments.src: Hasil = ditentukan oleh faktor pembatas terkecil
segments.tr: Hasil = ditentukan oleh faktor pembatas terkecil

segments.src: Ini sebabnya seorang agronom tidak buru-buru menaburkan pupuk saat melihat tanaman lesu, tapi bertanya dulu: tahap apa ini, dan faktor mana yang sedang jadi penghambat?
segments.tr: This is why an agronomist does not rush to scatter fertilizer when seeing a sluggish plant, but asks first: what stage is this, and which factor is currently acting as a bottleneck?

segments.src: ## Dalam keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Everyday Life

segments.src: Coba lihat sepiring nasi goreng di warung dekat rumah — anggaplah di Bandung atau Surabaya, harganya sekitar Rp 18.000.
segments.tr: Take a look at a plate of fried rice at a neighborhood warung — suppose in Bandung or Surabaya, costing around Rp 18,000.

segments.src: Isinya sebenarnya adalah pelajaran agronomi lengkap.
segments.tr: Its contents are actually a complete agronomy lesson.

segments.src: **Nasinya** berasal dari padi, tanaman pangan serealia, semusim.
segments.tr: **The rice** comes from paddy, a cereal food crop, an annual.

segments.src: Petani di Karawang atau Klaten menanamnya dua sampai tiga kali setahun.
segments.tr: Farmers in Karawang or Klaten plant it two to three times a year.

segments.src: Mereka tidak menghitung hari sembarangan: pemupukan susulan diberikan sekitar hari ke-21 dan ke-40 setelah tanam, tepat saat fase anakan aktif.
segments.tr: They do not count days carelessly: supplemental fertilization is given around the 21st and 40th day after planting, precisely during the active tillering phase.

segments.src: Sawah dikeringkan sebentar (*pengeringan berkala*) di tengah musim, lalu diairi lagi menjelang berbunga — karena saat malai keluar, kekurangan air bisa membuat gabah hampa.
segments.tr: The paddies are drained briefly (*alternate wetting and drying*) mid-season, then irrigated again approaching flowering — because when the panicles emerge, water shortage can make the grains empty.

segments.src: Hampa artinya kulitnya ada tapi isinya kosong, dan itu langsung memotong hasil panen.
segments.tr: Empty means the husk is there but the inside is vacant, and that directly cuts the harvest yield.

segments.src: **Kecapnya** manis karena gula, dan gulanya dari tebu — tanaman industri.
segments.tr: **The soy sauce** is sweet because of sugar, and the sugar comes from sugarcane — an industrial crop.

segments.src: Tebu tidak dipanen saat "besar", tapi saat kadar sukrosanya puncak, sekitar 10–12 bulan, dan biasanya di akhir musim kemarau.
segments.tr: Sugarcane is not harvested when "big", but when its sucrose content peaks, around 10–12 months, and usually at the end of the dry season.

segments.src: Kalau hujan turun deras menjelang panen, tebu akan tumbuh lagi dan justru "memakan" gulanya sendiri untuk pertumbuhan baru.
segments.tr: If heavy rain falls near harvest, sugarcane will grow again and actually "consume" its own sugar for new growth.

segments.src: Petani tebu di Jawa Timur karena itu memantau kalender kemarau sama serius seperti petani padi memantau hujan.
segments.tr: Sugarcane farmers in East Java therefore monitor the dry season calendar as seriously as rice farmers monitor rain.

segments.src: **Telur dan ayamnya** makan pakan yang sebagian besar jagung — tanaman C4 yang efisien di panas terik Sumbawa atau Lampung.
segments.tr: **The eggs and chicken** eat feed that is mostly corn — a C4 plant efficient in the scorching heat of Sumbawa or Lampung.

segments.src: **Cabai dan bawang merah** di dalamnya adalah hortikultura.
segments.tr: **Chili peppers and shallots** in it are horticulture.

segments.src: Harganya naik-turun tajam justru karena dua sifat tadi: cepat rusak dan panennya serempak.
segments.tr: Their prices swing wildly precisely because of those two traits: perishable and harvested simultaneously.

segments.src: Ketika panen raya bawang di Brebes bertemu, harga jatuh; sebulan kemudian bisa naik dua kali lipat.
segments.tr: When the shallot bumper harvest in Brebes coincides, prices crash; a month later they can double.

segments.src: Dan **kopi** yang Anda pesan setelahnya?
segments.tr: And **the coffee** you order afterwards?

segments.src: Tanaman industri tahunan.
segments.tr: A perennial industrial crop.

segments.src: Pohon kopi arabika di dataran tinggi Gayo atau Toraja baru berbuah pertama pada tahun ke-3, dan puncak produktivitasnya bertahun-tahun kemudian.
segments.tr: Arabica coffee trees in the highlands of Gayo or Toraja only bear fruit for the first time in the 3rd year, and their peak productivity is years later.

segments.src: Petani kopi berinvestasi dalam skala waktu yang sama sekali berbeda dari petani cabai — dan itulah kenapa risiko, pembiayaan, dan kebijakan untuk keduanya juga tidak bisa disamakan.
segments.tr: Coffee farmers invest on an entirely different time scale from chili farmers — and that is why risk, financing, and policies for both cannot be equated.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan 3 baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Tanaman budidaya dikelompokkan menurut kegunaannya (pangan, industri/perkebunan, hortikultura, pakan), umurnya (semusim vs tahunan), dan jalur fotosintesisnya (C3 vs C4).
segments.tr: 1. Cultivated plants are grouped by utility (food, industrial/estate, horticulture, forage), age (annual vs perennial), and photosynthetic pathway (C3 vs C4).

segments.src: 2. Setiap tanaman melewati fase vegetatif (daun, akar, anakan) lalu fase generatif (bunga, biji, buah); kebutuhan air dan hara berbeda di tiap fase, dan fase berbunga umumnya paling peka terhadap kekeringan.
segments.tr: 2. Every plant goes through a vegetative phase (leaves, roots, tillers) then a generative phase (flowers, seeds, fruit); water and nutrient needs differ in each phase, and the flowering phase is generally most sensitive to drought.

segments.src: 3. Pertumbuhan ditentukan oleh iklim, tanah, faktor biotik, dan pengelolaan — dan menurut hukum minimum, hasil dibatasi oleh faktor yang paling kurang, bukan rata-ratanya.
segments.tr: 3. Growth is determined by climate, soil, biotic factors, and management — and according to the law of the minimum, yield is limited by the most scarce factor, not its average.

segments.tr: **3.** (True/False) According to Liebig's law of the minimum, if one nutrient is severely deficient, crop yield can still be increased by adding other nutrients that are already sufficient.

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Tanaman pangan (food crop)** — tanaman yang hasilnya dikonsumsi langsung sebagai sumber energi atau gizi, seperti padi, jagung, singkong, dan kedelai.
segments.tr: - **Food crop** — plants whose yield is consumed directly as a source of energy or nutrition, such as rice, corn, cassava, and soybean.

segments.src: - **Tanaman industri (industrial/perkebunan crop)** — tanaman yang hasilnya diolah dulu menjadi produk lain, seperti tebu untuk gula, kapas untuk serat, dan kelapa sawit untuk minyak.
segments.tr: - **Industrial/estate crop** — plants whose yield is processed first into other products, such as sugarcane for sugar, cotton for fiber, and oil palm for oil.

segments.src: - **Fase vegetatif** — periode ketika tanaman membangun organ non-reproduktif: akar, batang, daun, dan anakan.
segments.tr: - **Vegetative phase** — the period when the plant builds non-reproductive organs: roots, stems, leaves, and tillers.

segments.src: - **Fase generatif (reproduktif)** — periode pembentukan bunga, penyerbukan, pengisian biji atau buah, hingga pemasakan.
segments.tr: - **Generative (reproductive) phase** — the period of flower formation, pollination, seed or fruit filling, up to ripening.

segments.src: - **Hukum minimum (Liebig)** — prinsip bahwa hasil panen dibatasi oleh faktor pertumbuhan yang paling kurang tersedia, bukan oleh rata-rata seluruh faktor.
segments.tr: - **Law of the minimum (Liebig)** — the principle that crop yield is limited by the least available growth factor, not by the average of all factors.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1 → (B).
segments.tr: *Answers: 1 → (B).

segments.src: Tebu, kapas, dan tembakau tidak dimakan langsung; hasilnya diolah menjadi gula, serat, dan produk tembakau, sehingga masuk kelompok tanaman industri/perkebunan.
segments.tr: Sugarcane, cotton, and tobacco are not eaten directly; their yield is processed into sugar, fiber, and tobacco products, making them part of the industrial/estate crop group.

segments.src: Saat berbunga dan mengisi gabah, tanaman tidak lagi punya waktu untuk memulihkan diri; cekaman air di titik ini menghasilkan gabah hampa dan langsung memotong hasil.
segments.tr: When flowering and filling grain, the plant no longer has time to recover; water stress at this point results in empty grains and directly cuts yield.

segments.src: Kekeringan di fase vegetatif awal masih bisa dikompensasi sebagian oleh pertumbuhan berikutnya.
segments.tr: Drought in the early vegetative phase can still be partially compensated by subsequent growth.

segments.src: 3 → Salah.
segments.tr: 3 → False.

segments.src: Justru sebaliknya: faktor yang paling kurang itulah yang membatasi hasil.
segments.tr: Quite the opposite: the most scarce factor is what limits the yield.

segments.src: Menambah unsur lain yang sudah cukup tidak akan menaikkan panen sampai faktor pembatasnya diperbaiki lebih dulu.*
segments.tr: Adding other elements that are already sufficient will not raise the harvest until the limiting factor is fixed first.*
